nom: NUXE Merveillance Lift Tinted Eye-Lighter Serum for Under Eye, 0.4 Fl Oz

avis.texte: This is a review of "NUXE Merveillance Lift Eye Lighter Serum with Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide, and Caffeine. Brightens, Smooths and Hydrates Eye Contour. Reduces All Types of Dark Circles, 0.4 Fl Oz". This eye serum arrived quickly and sealed in a branded box. The product descriptions says that from the first application, all types of dark circles are reduced and that the eye contour is more even and visibly enhanced for 93% of women. The applicator unscrews to reveal a brush that is very similar, if not identical, to the kinds that lip gloss tubes utilize. The serum is opaque, pink, and kind of shimmery. I was disappointed to see the shimmer when opening the tube, but my mind was changed as soon as I applied it to my skin. Somehow, the pink blended into my tan skin perfectly and immediately seemed to flatten out (disguise) the lower eye bags that I struggle to hide. My eye appearance truly was improved right away, and there was a slight tingly (likely from the caffeine) that seemed to be working hard to constrict my blood vessels and successfully reduced the puffiness from my bags. I have been using this regularly since receiving it, and I am so happy with the consistent results. This really does make a difference in my appearance and has successfully helped me reduce my bags. This blends in so well to match my skintone, so you can't even see it on my skin, despite the pearly appearance on the applicator. My mom (who is in her 80s) also tried this, but she had mixed result

avis.titre: More makeup than serum.More makeup than serum.
avis.texte: I wasn't expecting so much color in this eye lighter serum. I had assumed it would just absorb into the skin and that the ingredients--particularly the caffeine--would do any actual lightening of the under eye area. This was almost mauve compared to my pale skin tone, and the lip-gloss style applicator was heavily coated after shaking and it went on more heavily than I'd intended. While it did blend a little lighter, it felt to me like it highlighted the fine lines and slight bags under my eyes with the shine it put on my skin rather than concealing them. (The photos I took seem to have an auto beauty filter that I can't remove, because it looks a lot less severe a color difference than in real life.) This would probably work fine for most people, but I don't wear makeup and didn't have anything with which to try and blend this to look more natural. And again, I wasn't expecting a serum to have this much color in the first place. I'd call it makeup with moisturizers.

This eye serum is amazing! I love it. It has all of the ingredients that are known to be good to help with undereye bags and darkness, such as caffiene, hyaluronic , acid and niacinamide, but it also has the ability to hide the darkness on the spot. It isn't really makeup, but it does conceal the darkness while still feeling very hydrating. The concealing part of this formulation is very subtle. I don't wear makeup; I dislike the way it looks on my skin. This si so subtle that it still allows for the natural skin to show through. There is no caking or creasing. My skin does not at all feel covered, if that makes sense. It is truly skincare. A small amount of the blue underneath the eyes still shows through. I find this to be a positive. We all have some blue under the eyes and if we don't we are likely caked with makeup and the overall effect is airbrushed and unnatural. It also blends very well. I also like how this is botanically oriented as sustainably sourced. I love this brand, and I am very happy with this purchase.

I was pleasantly surprised by this. When I pulled out the wand, I was pretty surprised at how pink it was. I thought... there's no way this will cover my dark blue undereye circles, it's got too much red, it's going to just leave it looking purple. I put on a swipe under my eyes and I was surprised that it does actually cover the blue without leaving a purple tone behind. It's definitely pink and doesn't really match my pale skin tone, so I took my fingers and gently started to pat to blend it out, thinking that as I blended, surely it would end up taking too much coverage away and the blue would re-appear... well, that was also an incorrect assumption. It blended very nicely, very smooth, and it didn't make the coverage under the eye any less impactful. I was able to blend it out into the rest of my skin without much effort and it looks very natural while also covering my super blue undereye circles. It doesn't look caked on or thick, it doesn't crease or become more noticeable as the day goes on. This is NOT an undereye concealer, though... so don't expect that it's going to do a full-coverage heavy duty job. But if you're looking for a lighter every day look without so much product (as I and my aging skin am increasingly looking for,) this does the job. I wore it by itself one day and it lasted all day. It came off easily in the evening with my usual face wash. I then wore it underneath my tinted moisturizer. Blends well under that and I actually love that I don't need to

avis.titre: works like a dark peach color corrector for me, some nice eye skin friendly ingredientsworks like a dark peach color cor
avis.texte: I was initially a bit confused by this product. It says that it is an illuminating serum and so I expected the chemicals to help brighten my skin. The actual serum turned out to be pretty heavily pigmented like a make-up, so in practice I would call this a light color corrector. This a make up product then that has some nice skin friendly ingredients like niacinamide and HYA. I like how the serum feels. It is fairly thin and blends pretty easily, but in my dry climate it also dries pretty quickly. I found that I was able to layer my creamy concealer over this product pretty easily so long as I did not wait too long. If it dries out too much I noticed pilling. I also think with the HYA ingredient that my skin needs to be moist on application for the smoothest look. The applicator is narrow and works ok for product dotting, but maybe not for blending. I am rather pale and have dry, sensitive skin. The correcting tint is a peach color for dark circles and it is a little darker than my normal color corrector, but maybe a bit thinner (see photo for color comparison). It works fine on my pale skin after blending with my other complexion product. Overall I think this works fine and I like it, but make sure you know what you are purchasing! I personally prefer not to wear make up or color corrector to bed, so this is a pre-makeup morning product for me!

avis.titre: Very useful; Light makeupVery useful; Light makeup
avis.texte: I have been using this NUXE Merveillance Lift Eye Lighter Serum for several days now, and, spoiler alert!--I think it's great. It isn't quite what I was expecting when I ordered it, but the formulation works so well on me that I think this is something that I won't EVER be without. Why am I jumping for joy over this? First of all, this isn't a squeeze tube. You unscrew the top to pull out a sponge-tip applicator from the tube. It looks much more like makeup than a serum, because the formula is a light, faintly opalescent, pale-skin-toned cream. Even as a cream, this is thin, and yes, feels like the serum that it is. I dot about three circles under my eyes with the tip of the applicator, and then with my fingers or a brush, I buff the serum into my undereyes. It is important to note that I am pale, and this color would match my skin tone pretty perfectly. I am not sure about other skin tones, but I think it must be pretty universal, since the serum sinks into my skin and leaves a brightness, not a color, behind. The serum deposits the pretty, opalescent color under my eyes and leaves a concentrated brightness . This smooths the look of lines and hollows under my eyes, and helps to hide any shadows. Another excellent thing about this serum is that it helps make my under eyes a smooth canvas for concealer. I don't need very much concealer when I am using this serum. Most of the time, I don't bother with concealer when I am wearing this. However, it is VERY sheer, and not meant t

avis.titre: Not suitable for all skin tonesNot suitable for all skin tones
avis.texte: I love caffeine eye serums for depuffing and brightening so this seemed like a good option from one of my favorite brands. However the product is very pink-orange and far too pigmented for my skin. Even sheered out it still looked orange on me.

avis.titre: More make up than skincareMore make up than skincare
avis.texte: This is a nice make up / skincare cross over product. It comes inside a box, and is a tube with a foam applicator to apply the product. The product is unscented, and has a medium and somewhat tacky consistency and dewy finish. So if you prefer a matte look, this is not for you. But if you have dry or mature skin then this may suit you. The product applies under your eyes, and I was surprised how dark / orange this is. It is definitely designed to color cancel purple shadows under your eyes. It was a hot dark for me personally, and actually the color wS more opaque than expected. If I use it under concealer then it works better for me. I love that it has skincare benefits, which a lot of make up products do not, so this makes a really nice change. Nuxe is a favorite of mine, and I will definitely buy some more of their products in the future.

Allerdings ist der Aufhell-Effekt nur sehr leicht. Das Produkt ist aber eine gute Basis für einen leichten Concealer. Kleines Problem für Kontaktlinsen-Tägerinnen: wenn das Produkt in die Augen kriecht, bildet sich ein „Schleier“. Daher mit etwas Abstand auftragen.
Neutralizza il blu/viola delle mie occhiaie e illumina leggermente
Nutre, illumina, non segna perché è molto fluido, ma sicuramente non copre l'occhiaia. Ottimo prodotto se non avete occhiaie scure.
Sicuramente aiuta il contorno occhi a migliorare le occhiaie. Borse sotto gli occhi non ne ho quindi non posso scrivere nulla. Ottimo prodotto
ci vuole molta manualità,con capelli grossi e mossi prima si passa la ciocca poi si può dare movimento meglio usare ciocche piccole. Promossa ma non per tutti

This is the first product that I've tried from the Nuxe brand, and I'm very impressed. For me, it's hard to find quality concealers/color correctors/highlighters etc. for use around my eyes because most are either too sticky or tacky, too dark, too light, make my under eye area look crepey, or they do absolutely nothing to improve dark circles. This serum does none of those things. It's a thinner consistency and at first glance it appears as though it may be too pink or dark, but when applied it really does lighten and brighten. It's not shimmery or glittery, just pure luminescence. I tried to capture this in my pictures. As you can see, the product appears to be a different color than the skin on my hand, but when blended out, it's luminous. The light reflecting particles do a great job of camouflaging the darkness beneath my eyes. I can also apply a powder concealer over it without creasing or losing the light reflecting qualities. It also doesn't irritate my sensitive skin or make my eyes water or burn, and it rates "Excellent" on Yuka for clean ingredients. I would definitely purchase this again and I highly recommend it!

I ordered the NUXE Merveillance Lift Eye Lighter Serum based on the description. When I saw the ingredients included Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide, and Caffeine I knew my eye area would look better afterwards. These three ingredients are the holy trinity of most eye creams. I was surprised that the serum was tinted but it goes on smoothly and blends into my skin color completely. Nice. This serum helped with dark circles but wasn't really hydrating enough for my mature skin. Immediately after applying this my eyes looked brighter and the fine lines were plumped out. After an hour or so the hydration captured by the hyaluronic acid dissipated and my eyes showed those lines again. This is an odd formulation for a serum. Traditional skincare says serum first then a moisturizer. Since this serum has a pigment it seems weird to then apply another cream, and it isn't hydrating enough on it's own without an eye cream. I like it but do not feel it is worth the current price of $58.00. There are options for half this price which do as well.

I was excited about the concept of this, seemingly all in one under eye product, but it really didn’t deliver for me at all. I was quite surprised to see the color of it when I first pulled the wand out. It is like your typical concealer wand, but yet the color is quite a bright orange pink and I have very fair skin…I thought there is no way that it would work on my coloring. I was glad to see that it didn’t contain any added fragrance and I definitely didn’t smell any scent. Thankfully, it didn’t cause any irritation under my eye which is a win, but it really didn’t cover my dark circles at all. I am going to try it a few more times because I feel like maybe I am missing something, but my initial impression isn’t great. I prefer sticking with the eye serum that I already use and applying my favorite concealer over it.… It would be nice though, if those two products could be combined in one, I just don’t think this one is it unfortunately.

This NUXE Lift Eye Lighter Serum was just so-so for me. It has some effective ingredients in it like hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and caffeine. It claims it brightens, smooths and hydrates your under eye area and helps to reduce dark circles. While I thought it helped to reduce the appearance of my dark circles, I didn’t necessarily feel like it smoothed or hydrated underneath my eyes. It comes in a container that looks more like a concealer or lip color because it has a wand and it’s a reddish brown color. The color does blend in under the eyes and you don’t see it once it’s rubbed in. Although I could see it a little bit in the creases under my eyes a few hours later. It did not bother my sensitive skin, which I was happy about. I’ll continue using it and hopefully over time it will make a difference in the under eye area. This would be a big splurge for me at $58.00.

avis.titre: Does reduce the look of my dark circles, but not hydrating for me.
avis.texte: I do love many of the NUXE products! But, this NUXE Merveillance life eye lighter serum on gets a four star rating due to the following: 1. The color on of mine, even after shaking the tube, is darker than it should be. 2. This is easy to apply with the sponge applicator. However it goes on my under eye too dry, not hydrating. 3. Cost, this comes in at $145.00 an ounce. For now, I will continue to use as the instructions say, but, will add a small amount of moisture under my eye before applying. After continued use, if I see improvement and if it goes on sale, I would purchase again.

avis.titre: Not my favorite but it works pretty well…
avis.texte: This NUXE Merveillance Lift Eye Lighter Serum isn’t my favorite eye corrector, but it does work well and has some amazing ingredients and benefits to it! I have fairly sensitive skin and have had no adverse reactions. The color does help brighten up my under eyes, but I also still have a decent tan from the summer. I feel like once my tan starts to fade, it won’t look as good and will be more noticeable and not as natural looking… This is a hybrid - a serum and makeup product in one. It’s supposed to help hydrate, firm, and visibly reduce fine lines while brightening tired eyes. It does have some amazing skincare ingredients such as: hyaluronic acid, niacinamide and caffeine. I do feel like it does help with the morning puffiness and does help brighten up my under eyes but again, it’s just not my favorite out there…

avis.titre: Disappointing for the Price and Too Bright and Sticky for Daily Use
avis.texte: The NUXE Merveillance Lift Eye Lighter Serum was a letdown for me. The color is a very bright pink, which really stands out against my pale skin and not in a flattering way. It might work better for other skin tones, but on me it just looks mismatched. Besides the color, the texture is thick and a bit sticky, making it unattractive to wear during the day. It’s not something I could easily layer makeup over, so if I use it at all, it’ll be as a nighttime treatment instead. But for that I would prefer to just stick to a clear, lightweight serum. For a product at this luxury price point, I was expecting a smoother texture and a more universally flattering formula. Unfortunately, this one just doesn’t deliver.

avis.titre: Effective serum but I wish you got more
avis.texte: I like this serum overall. It's easy to apply. A little does go a long way. I think it works well and is effective. It doesn't irritate my skin as well which is really important especially for under my eyes. I do notice a difference. The only thing is the value for the money. I feel you should get more for the price. So you kind of have to outweigh that. I think you need more in the tube it's kind of small for how much it is.

I prefer to wear a very light makeup and use a very thin under eye concealer on occasion. I like to use it to brighten the eye area. Naturally I like it when the concealer is packed with goodies to help the fine lines, wrinkles etc. I don’t have a puffy eye area but this has caffeine that should help with that. I do have fine lines so the niacinamide in it is appreciated. And the Nuxe is thin and not heavy. So while I like it in theory, the problem I have with it is the color. It’s an orangey pink that on fair skin like mine looks dark, muddy and conceals nothing. I’ve can’t speak for how it would work on other skin tones but it does not work on mine.

I like the ingredients in this eye lighter serum. I thought I would like the product, but I don’t. I do not like the color or the consistency of this eye serum. I also do not like the applicator or the stickiness of this product. It doesn’t go on smooth, and I feel like it’s stretching the delicate eye area skin when I apply it. I guess this product is not for me.

avis.titre: Eye serum, far more color than I expected.
avis.texte: This is a serum for the eye area, made in France. It has a nice wand with a sponge tip applicator. This product has a *lot* of color that I did not expect. The shade is a pink with brown tones. I am fairly pale and this just looks odd on me. I was not aware there would be this much color (or any to be honest). The color issue aside, this is quite effective smoothing fine lines around the eye. It is also non-irritating. It’s just not what I wanted or needed from an eye serum.

avis.titre: Creamy consistency and color is perfect for my mature skin
avis.texte: I have tried so many color correctors for underneath my eyes and always end up disappointed, so I wasn’t expecting a lot. This is the ONE. It comes in a small tube with a wand you’d normally see with lip glosses. The color is a pink/peach that perfectly helps to correct the blue/gray tint I have under my eyes. The consistency is absolutely perfect. Most color correctors either tug at my delicate skin or end up leaving it look cakey. This one actually delivers moisture in the form of hyaluronic acid to make the undereye are look and feel hydrated. It looks good even after drying. I love that it also includes niacinamide and caffeine for brightening and de-puffing. At my age I struggle with applying any concealers because they all end up enhancing the crepey skin under my eyes so I love that this corrects the dark tone and also hydrates so I can go straight to applying my foundation. Overall, I couldn’t be happier with how good this works. I just wish it wasn’t so expensive 🥺.

avis.titre: Good so far on sensitive skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using this eye serum for a little while, and so far, it’s been very gentle on my sensitive skin, which I really appreciate. It’s unscented, so there’s no fragrance to irritate the delicate under-eye area—a big plus for anyone prone to reactions. The texture is light and easily absorbed, so it layers well under my moisturizer and makeup without feeling greasy or heavy. My under-eye area feels hydrated and soft, though I can’t say I’ve noticed dramatic changes in dark circles yet. I think that’s typical with serums—consistent use over time is likely necessary to see real results. I also like that the formula includes niacinamide, caffeine, and hyaluronic acid, all ingredients that have a good track record for brightening and smoothing the eye area. The bottle is small, but it seems well-concentrated, so a little goes a long way, which helps with value given the price point. Overall, this feels like a high-quality, gentle eye serum that’s safe for sensitive skin, hydrating, and pleasant to use, even if you may need several weeks of use to notice visible brightening or reduction in dark circles.

This is a fantastic eye lightener! It’s lighter than traditional heavy concealer, and the deep pink hue blends in beautifully to balance out dark under eye circles quickly. I was concerned that it wouldn’t blend well because it’s thick, but it smoothed into my skin really well and just disappeared (and took my dark circles with it). It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and healthy, and says it’ll help with skin health over time. Based on the ingredients, I have confidence it will help, though products like this can take a couple months to see lasting effects. So, I’ll keep using it every morning. Even if all it does is let me ditch my heavy concealer, I’m thrilled with it! It’s definitely worth the price point because it’s a good sized tube and a little goes a really long way. This also blended and layered really seemlessly under my foundation with no pilling or caking, so it’s a win for me! Highly recommend!

I really like this eye cream. I feel it great for AM care and I use it after cleansing my face. I do not put toner around my eyes so this is the first thing to go there. A little goes a long way, just a tiny bit and I tap in with my fingers which provides nice little massage. I feel like it helps with my puffy eyes. Not sure about dark circles but I think my eyes look brighter overall so I think it helps. The cream is soft, absorbs fast and it has very mild smell but it evaporates fast and it’s not bothering at all (and I am pregnant so very sensitive to smells right now).

avis.titre: You can use it as a color corrector for under eyes too
avis.texte: NUXE is a really good grand and I have tried some of their skin products before so I was curious to try this Lift Eye Lighter Serum. The packaging is well designed and nice and has about 0.4 fl oz of light creamy textured. The serum has some peachy tint to it and even though it’s very easy to blend on the skin but because it has light coverage, I think you can also use it as color corrector as well. It’s made with Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide, and Caffeine and helps Brightening and smoothing the skin around the eyes.
